Began OK. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (6L from lead). Back 2 Lengths midrace until pushed along 3 Wide @ 500m. Chasing Four Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & held up @ 150m. Made late ground. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward Settled Down 3rd fence 2 Lengths 800m 4th 3 Lengths home turn 5th rails run Kept Going Ok Straight # every ch/ready

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated that his mount was under pressure from the 800m and was ultimately disappointing in the manner in which it closed off its race. He added that whilst in his opinion, his mnt did not appreciate the kickback from today’s surface, he further stated that the gelding may have come to the end of its preparation. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding revealed no abnormalities. Trainer subsequently advised Stewards that the gelding would now be spelled.
